CTL-03.note: Twin: no second approval for propulsion arming from a single console.

CTL-13.note: Schedule change through provider API not alerted.

TRN-01.note: One file-transfer path from enterprise to mission found; inspected but not content-filtered.

MNP-04.note: Products not signed between processing and delivery.

MNP-12.note: Pass plan is reconciled after execution, not before.
